notes: OPEN QUESTION — IDENTITY UNSETTLED (research 2026-07-03): a wife named Christian Gard/Guard for Peter Coffin Sr. (1671–1749) is attested in multiple secondary sources and independently corroborated by this repo's own line-coffin.md, but her identity is genuinely contested in the literature — variously identified as "Christian Gard," "Christian Guard," and "Christian Condy/Conde," sometimes treated as the same woman under spelling variants and sometimes as different women. Her export parentage (William Gard x Mary Mariah Jameson) was not independently corroborated this pass. Sources: Geni: Peter Coffin (1671–1749); this repo's line-coffin.md.
